elaine (docs): quick heads-up — PR #487 adds rust SDK snippet, updates migration guide, and fixes a few doc links. netlify preview failed on fonts 😕. Anyone available to review + re-run preview?

mike (devex): I'll take a look in ~30m. what's the netlify error?

netlify-bot: Preview build for PR #487 failed — deploy log excerpt: ERROR 403: /assets/fonts/inter.woff2 — Access denied (CORS). See https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-inference/deploys/12345

jamal (eng): I saw this earlier. Usually the CDN headers in netlify.toml need a rule for /assets/* with Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Elaine, did the PR move fonts into `docs/static/` or `static/`?

elaine (docs): moved to docs/static/fonts to make local preview simpler. netlify.toml in repo root currently has headers only for /static/, not /docs/static. quick hack: add this to netlify.toml — can someone confirm?

```toml
[[headers]]
for = "/docs/static/*"
[headers.values]
Access-Control-Allow-Origin = "*"
```

mike (devex): quick patch LGTM. I'm going to re-run preview. Also FYI CI is a bit backed up — re-runs get queued.

ci-bot: Rebuild triggered by mike (devex) for PR #487. Build queued (position 7).

lara (docs): If preview takes long, you can run locally: `pipx run mkdocs serve` or via docker: `docker run --rm -v $(pwd):/docs squidfunk/mkdocs-material:latest mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000`

elaine (docs): adding the local snippet to the PR description. prefer to hold merge until a green preview and at least one approver. Can we use the 11pm merge slot tonight? I'm in PST so that's fine for me.

jamal (eng): 11pm works. @mike please assign at least one reviewer from eng-runtime as well — the snippet touches runtime config.

mike (devex): assigned @noah. quick note: when merging, choose 'squash' to keep the changelog tidy.

noah (eng-runtime): got it. will eyeball the kernel example and run the sample snippet locally.

elaine (docs): cool — I'll wait for netlify success + noah's approve. thanks all :thumbsup:
